title: Elicit
description: Elicit — Autonomous Research-to-Prototype Engine (public edition). Real documented tool; god-mode caveat applies.
body: Elicit is a real, publicly documented software tool relevant to Autonomous Research-to-Prototype Engine. Ought's AI research assistant that turns questions into structured literature reviews with cited claims. In the context of the god-mode vision, it represents the current real-world state of the art for part of what "Autonomous Research-to-Prototype Engine" aspires to do: Turns a research question into a hypothesis, prototype, experiments, and an evaluation report.. Its documented capabilities include agent coordination and requirement analysis, and it is used in production or research settings today.
